# Yana Harcourt - Web & UX/UI Designer, Bray, Ireland

> Yana Harcourt is a UX/UI designer and front-end developer based in Bray, Co. Wicklow, Ireland. She designs and builds websites and redesigns outdated sites for startups, founders and small businesses across Ireland and remotely. Languages: English, Russian.
